# Getting help with Northstar DevKit

- **Bug reports and feature requests:**
  [open an issue](https://github.com/belous-ilya/northstar-devkit/issues/new/choose)
- **Questions and ideas:**
  [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/belous-ilya/northstar-devkit/discussions)
- **Security vulnerabilities:** see [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md) — please do not
  open a public issue
- **Anything else, including questions about the GitHub integration:**
  [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/belous-ilya/northstar-devkit/discussions)
